title: USER_V1
description: JSON schema for Observe.ai bulk S3 export of user records. Each file is gzip-compressed JSON (USER_V1_<timestamp>.json.gz). Each record is one JSON object.

enabled.description: Whether the user account is enabled.

teamids.description: Identifiers of teams the user belongs to.

role.description: Role assigned to the user (e.g. AGENT, ADMIN, EVALUATOR).

created_at.description: UTC timestamp when the record was created.

modified_at.description: UTC timestamp when the record was last modified.
